item.description: A major Rutland area drug dealer was sentenced to over seven years in prison. Guadalupe Vargas ran a drug operation using apartments in Rutland City. Authorities seized drugs, guns, and cash linked to gang activity and a California murder.
A Port Henry man was arrested after an assault in Moriah, New York. The New York State Police are investigating the case. Further details have not been disclosed.

Vermont recorded the lowest foreclosure rate in the nation in August, with one foreclosure per nearly sixty-eight thousand homes. Foreclosures in Vermont dropped fourteen percent compared to last year, while national rates rose. Most Vermont homeowners have significant equity, helping them avoid foreclosure.

Average gas prices in the area have dropped six point seven cents to four dollars thirty-two cents per gallon. Prices are down twenty point three cents from last month but still a dollar fifteen cents higher than last year. The national average fell below four dollars per gallon for the first time since early August.
